caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil on a light background and features a central emblem framed by ornate scrollwork. At the top, a banner inscribed with the word "DIRIGO" arcs above a large pine tree. Below the pine tree, there is a reclining moose. To the left of the emblem stands a human figure dressed in work clothes and a brimmed hat, holding a scythe, with a bundle of grain or wheat beside the figure. To the right of the emblem, another human figure wearing similar clothing and a hat leans on an anchor. At the bottom, a flowing ribbon with the word "MAINE" is displayed, following the curvature of the scrollwork. The entire drawing is monochromatic, using shades of gray and fine penciled lines for detail and shading.
title: State of Maine Seal
